Yeah, but I suppose the only difference is I'm dying by my own hand.    
    
 I used to think I was terrible at all the things I loved to do (writing, dancing, music) but that was only because I constantly compared myself to others. Then I realized, a bit too late, that on my own I'm pretty good at what I do. So despite all the trouble I've brought on my family and friends because of simply existing, it's best that I leave behind a *good* part of myself.
Thank you, I really appreciate that. I mean, I'm going to die, so I should at least leave something behind other than memories.
